response_texts: Professor, are you awake? I need to talk to you.
Oh, it's you. Of course I'm awake. We lost our ability to sleep a long time ago...
So what do you want, Boltzmer?
Professor, our experiment failed.
This is a matter of perspective. You are too impatient. Now we need to wait.
What exactly are you waiting for? And how long do you intend to wait?
For the one who stands on Mnemo-Li, the Blue Orphan. We did not qualify for it... This is why I can only wait now.
...I can't wait any longer. So this is our farewell, professor.
After all this, you're leaving, too. I'll miss you... a little.
Felix... It's so good to see you at last... At last... I found the Red Drop at last...
Now we're both together again... We don't have to fight anymore... We don't have to kill anyone anymore...
Take it... I don't think I can move anymore... I can't feel my legs...
Filthy little scurrying rats, scrabbling for gold... Your crimes are heavy, aren't they?
Shut up! Come out at once!
So aggressive... Fine, then we'll do it the hard way. You'll die lamenting your own weakness!
School expenses... No, the bounty will show up. Get ready!
All right, Skoll. Find that mushroom's smell.
He found something. Let's follow him!
Why is there cheese in this place? Does cheese grow from the ground?
The Lusty Argonian Maid Vol. 2? Is this a bread baking book? Let's show it to Groll later.
What is this stone? I hear something strange from it and it feels a bit disgusting...
A cave! I wonder if there's treasure inside... This is so exciting!
If you are blessed... remain pure. The Owl said so.
Such large feathers... I've never seen something like this.
The antidote is quite simple. All one needs is a little blood of each race, a bit of Nirnroot, and the Red Drop to soak it in the mixture.
There, all done, see? There are two pills. One for you and one for Ozwald. Ah, but Ozwald is no longer with us... So use the other one as you see fit, yes?
Why not use it on the chick, hmm? Perhaps it will restore her to full health.
The story of Polydor and Eloisa... What a depressing tale. It's all nothing but misery, nothing redeemable about.
Only a bad bard would love such a story. Don't you think so, too?
In the old days, Ysgramor followed a hare and found a beast lying in the depths. This is the truth the Daughters of Kyne should have kept until the days of Twilight.
In the old days, Yelem chased an owl and awoke the nightmare sleeping in the depths. This is the truth that should have dwelled in Ja'zel's womb.
Now, follow the smell of blood and crawl through the darkness with hatred and rage. Like Laza once did...
Look, Hjalti... Cuhlecain's successor really exists. I was right... You are not a traitor...
No need to burden yourself anymore, Hjalti... Let's go home together. Let's return to Alcaire...
If I may, kind one, could you please let me out of here?
I'm locked up and in trouble. Please, help me, I beg you.
Gold's still here... Can't be the bandits, then. They would've stolen even the hairs off his ass.
He's run outside... Let's go after him. It's not too late yet.
Lalanoah is always happy to eat whatever I cook for her, which makes it all the more worthwhile. So different from my husband who left me so long ago.
Now I look forward to seeing her enjoy my cooking. I feel rewarded for my work.
Taking care of Lalanoah reminds me of the daughter I've lost... People and rock trolls are so very different from each other.
I thought I was already over it, but for some reason she keeps reminding me of my daughter. I don't know why, but I love her as if she were my own.
O tainted one, your soul is only slightly stained. Turn back. For the Blue Star will not rise for you yet.
O tainted one, didn't Hamah warn you? You are not yet ready to reach the Blue Star.
O tainted one, you cannot reach the Blue Star yet. For it is only corruption and pain that can refine your very inner being.
O tainted one, you have ripened well even without knowing Hamah. Solitude must truly be your sole companion.
O tainted one, Hamah's voice has ripened you well. You may just be able to reach the Blue Star.
O filth nurturer, the number of lives writhing hideously within you makes my head spin. Surely no one before you has devoured so much flesh and blood.
O life devourer, all manner of life is nourished like maggots beneath your skin, dreaming an eternal dream.
Recall our words, spoken for your sake. Remember that forbidden deeds led you to this Spring.
Had you endured further corruption and suffering, you could have become something far sweeter. But if you fall now, none shall awaken from their slumber.
As long as the night sky persists, none shall awaken from the dream. The sea shall run dry here. You will fall, never to rise again.
Before you, the stars recoil and fall silent, and the unstars dance, celebrating their reunion with you. You are truly the Third Serpent.
But if you insist... then I shall trust Professor Yelem. Now is the time for the fated harvest.
The Blue Star's gaze remembers you and me facing each other. Her blessing is now here. It is time for harvest.
I shall devour your flesh and drink your blood dry. I shall partake of your Feast of Love, and embrace eternal life and a new world, within this very body.
O tainted soul. Can you not hear that baby's birthing cry? It may be a blue bird now, but it was not born blue.
You cannot be its wet nurse. So turn back. For we are all nothing but lice. Be proud and partake in Kyne's Feast of Love!
